title: Difficulty-Estimated Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2602.06375v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs), exemplified by DeepSeek-R1, have underscored the potential of scaling inference-time compute through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). However, GRPO frequently suffers from gradient signal attenuation when encountering problems that are either too trivial or overly complex. In these scenarios, the disappearance of inter-group advantages makes the gradient signal susceptible to noise, thereby jeopardizing convergence stability. While variants like DAPO attempt to rectify gradient vanishing, they do not alleviate the substantial computational overhead incurred by exhaustive rollouts on low-utility samples. In this paper, we propose Difficulty-Estimated Policy Optimization (DEPO), a novel framework designed to optimize the efficiency and robustness of reasoning alignment. translated_abstract: 以DeepSeek-R1为代表的大推理模型（LRMs）的最新进展，凸显了通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）来扩展推理时计算的潜力。然而，当遇到过于简单或过于复杂的问题时，GRPO经常遭受梯度信号衰减的困扰。在这些场景中，组间优势的消失使得梯度信号容易受到噪声影响，从而危及收敛的稳定性。虽然像DAPO这样的变体试图纠正梯度消失问题，但它们并未缓解在低效用样本上进行穷举式采样所产生的巨大计算开销。在本文中，我们提出了难度估计策略优化（DEPO），这是一个旨在优化推理对齐效率和鲁棒性的新框架。DEPO集成了一个在线难度估计器，可在训练前动态评估和过滤训练数据（摘要内容在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出DEPO框架，通过在线难度估计器动态评估和过滤训练数据，解决了GRPO在过易或过难问题上梯度信号衰减及低效用样本计算开销大的问题，提升了大推理模型推理对齐的效率与稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes DEPO, a novel framework that integrates an online Difficulty Estimator to dynamically assess and filter training data, addressing GRPO's gradient signal attenuation on trivial or overly complex problems and reducing computational overhead, thereby improving the efficiency and robustness of reasoning alignment for Large Reasoning Models.
